reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so a travel sachet solves a problem I don't have. The named lab and batch report are nice, but I'd still be paying $29.99 for something I already have on my shelf.
objection: I don't need it to go. I'm home every evening and already have a magnesium I trust, and I'd have to compare this against it before switching.
would_change_my_mind: If it were clearly cheaper per day than what I buy now and I could open a real lab report for a batch before ordering, I might try one box.
